title: Divisions of the Priests

questions.question: Who were the sons of Aaron?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:1 (ESV): "The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar."

questions.question: What happened to Nadab and Abihu?
options: They died before their father and had no children
questions.correctAnswer: They died before their father and had no children
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:2 (ESV): "But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children..."

questions.question: Who continued as priests?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:2 (ESV): "...so Eleazar and Ithamar became the priests."

questions.question: Who helped David organize them?
options: Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar
questions.correctAnswer: Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:3 (ESV): "With the help of Zadok... and Ahimelech..."

questions.question: Why were there more chief men found among the sons of Eleazar than Ithamar?
options: There were sixteen heads for Eleazar and eight for Ithamar
questions.correctAnswer: There were sixteen heads for Eleazar and eight for Ithamar
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:4 (ESV): "...so there were assigned sixteen heads of fathers' houses... and eight... of Ithamar."

questions.question: Who recorded the names?
options: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe
questions.correctAnswer: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:6 (ESV): "And Shemaiah... the scribe... recorded them..."

questions.question: To whom did the first lot fall?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:7 (ESV): "The first lot fell to Jehoiarib..."

questions.question: To whom did the twenty-fourth lot fall?
Who was the father of Ahimelech mentioned here?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:6 (ESV): "...and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar..."

questions.question: Those listed in verses 20-31 are the rest of whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:20 (ESV): "And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram..."

questions.question: How were lots cast for the rest of the Levites compared to the priests?
options: They cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aaron
They served by rotation solely on age
There were no lots for them
questions.correctAnswer: They cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aaron
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:31 (ESV): "These also... cast lots just as their brothers the sons of Aaron..."

questions.question: How were the head of the fathers' houses and his younger brother treated in the lot?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:31 (ESV): "...the head of a fathers' house and his younger brother alike."

questions.question: Who was the firstborn of Hebron?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:23 (ESV): "The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief..."

questions.question: Who was Isshiah the son of?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 24:21 (ESV): "The sons of Rehabiah... the chief was Isshiah."

key_verse_text: They organized them by lot, all alike, for there were officials of the sanctuary and officials of God among the sons of Eleazar and among the sons of Ithamar.
